text:
Ethene, propene and butene are all members of the same homologous series.
Which statement explains why ethene, propene and butene have similar chemical properties?
A
They all have the same functional group.
B
They are all gases at room temperature.
C
They are all hydrocarbons.
D
They are all organic.

options.label: A
options.text: They all have the same functional group.

options.label: B
options.text: They are all gases at room temperature.
